features.name: Per-keystroke inline-completion engine (Rust llama-cpp-2 sidecar)
features.description: True per-keystroke inline completion via a new Rust sidecar (owlet-engine) over a Unix domain socket: three-tier cascade (Tier 0 fst word-completion every keystroke, Tier 1 symspell recorrect, Tier 2 llama-cpp-2 GGUF continuation), with token-space KV-cache LCP-trim-on-edit + per-decode-step cancellation. Swift Host keeps AX/caret/overlay/accept/secure-field/TCC. Replaces the Ollama-HTTP path for AUTOCOMPLETE only; the rewriter stays on Ollama. v1 model = Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B GGUF (user-chosen default, plain prefix-continuation; base model selectable in picker). Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-01-per-keystroke-engine-design.md; plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-01-per-keystroke-engine.md.
features.evidence: APPROVED 2026-06-01 after a 6-claim adversarial hardening pass (workflow wf_70480b50-628, 12 agents). Locked decisions: Rust llama-cpp-2 sidecar over UDS (user-chosen runtime); code model default (user overrule of the evidence, which recommended a general/base model since FIM is inert in a prefix-only pipeline — recorded in design §4, one-line swap in picker). Hardening corrections folded into the design: (1) llama-cpp-2 0.1.146 method is clear_kv_cache_seq (NOT kv_cache_seq_rm; safe Rust), and a boundary trim is a PARTIAL removal that can return Ok(false) = silent no-op -> MUST check the bool; cancellation = caller AtomicBool between synchronous decode steps. (2) LCP/n_past math MUST use llama.cpp's own LlamaModel::str_to_token, NOT the HF tokenizers crate (silent KV desync otherwise). (3) Static-link ggml/llama (-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF) -> ZERO hardened-runtime entitlement exceptions; no allow-jit (Metal compiles shaders out-of-process); Owlet's self-signed 'Owlet Developer' cert has no Apple Team ID so the same-Team-ID LV escape hatch is unavailable. (4) Keep socket at ~/Library/Application Support/Owlet/engine.sock (59<104 bytes); supervisor MUST unlink() stale socket before each respawn or crash recovery silently dies on EADDRINUSE; Process+terminationHandler for supervision. (5) Caret one-line-too-high is NOT in the flip/anchor formulas (refuted via code+git history) -> diagnose the AX-rect data path on BOTH displays, no blind nudge. Build order (design §9): caret diagnostic -> engine skeleton (DONE) -> Host transport -> Tier 0 FST -> Tier 2 KV-cache+oracle -> Tier 1 SymSpell -> packaging. STEP 2 DONE (engine skeleton, headless-verified): new standalone crate tools/engine (owlet-engine), serde+serde_json only. proto.rs = message enums (HostMessage/EngineMessage/Trigger/Tier/Range) + length-prefixed JSON framing (4-byte BE len + UTF-8 JSON, internally-tagged {"type":...} for Swift Codable symmetry), partial-read-safe read loop, clean-EOF-at-boundary vs mid-frame-error, 4 MiB guard. main.rs = UDS listener (unlink stale socket + sun_path<104 guard), serve() loop Ping->Pong / Shutdown exits / ContextUpdate->placeholder echo (TEMP, replaced by Tier 0 in Step 4). VERIFIED: (cd tools/engine && cargo test) 13/13 pass; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; real UDS round-trip smoke via python AF_UNIX client (Ping->{type:Pong}, ContextUpdate seq5->{type:Suggestion,tier:Complete,text echo}, Shutdown logged). STEP 4 DONE (Tier 0 fst word completion, headless): src/tier0_fst.rs WordCompleter over fst::Map<u64> (value=frequency); trailing_partial_word extracts the caret partial word; complete_prefix returns the suffix finishing the highest-frequency dictionary word with that prefix, else None on trailing-space/unknown/exact/empty; case-insensitive match preserving caret casing; pure PREFIX completion (Levenshtein fuzzy is a documented follow-up, kept out so a typo can't masquerade as a completion - that is Tier 1). src/words_en.txt ~130-word common-English starter dict (include_str!, line order = frequency), expandable. main.rs Engine answers ContextUpdate with Tier 0 completion (tier=Complete) or stays silent; placeholder echo removed. VERIFIED: cargo test 20/20; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; real UDS smoke becaus->e, wel->l, trailing-space/unknown correctly silent; rewriter regression cargo test 50/50 (untouched). /CHECK (clean): preflight + fresh verify (engine 20/20, clippy clean); one safe_auto fix - added tools/engine/.gitignore (target/ + owlet-engine; Cargo.lock tracked); scope on target, no surprise deps, no hard stops. STEP 3 RESHAPED by advisor before writing Swift: a drop-in SidecarPredictor:Predicting is WRONG (cascade is multi-shot per ContextUpdate -> one-shot suggest()->String drops Tier 2 or loses instant Tier 0; behind the 120ms Swift debounce = zero per-keystroke gain = phantom milestone). Transport MUST be push/streaming. Split: 3a = IPC unit (EngineFraming/EngineClient/EngineSupervisor: spawn + terminationHandler + unlink-before-respawn + ping/pong + one real round-trip; NO controller change, 145 Swift tests stay green); 3b = streaming integration (SuggestionTransport push protocol; textChanged() sends ContextUpdate immediately, debounce moves INTO the engine; controller gains receive(seq,suggestion) on existing requestID/seq gate; Ollama Predicting stays behind Settings toggle as rollback; fake transport pushes MULTIPLE results). Plan+design docs updated. STEP 3a DONE (IPC unit, headless + real round-trip): EngineProtocol.swift (Codable mirror of proto.rs - internally-tagged HostMessage/EngineMessage, Trigger/SuggestionTier/ReplaceRange, app_id/replace_range wire keys; EngineFraming + FrameBuffer partial-read accumulator + 4MiB guard); EngineClient.swift (POSIX AF_UNIX client: sun_path<104 guard, SO_NOSIGPIPE, SO_RCVTIMEO timeout, persistent FrameBuffer); EngineSupervisor.swift (Process spawn + terminationHandler, unlink-before-respawn, respawn backoff, idempotent start, stop suppresses respawn; injectable launch/unlink/schedule; @MainActor-typed scheduler for Swift 6). NO AutocompleteController change.
